page.overview:
What is Conquest of Cato Neimoidia?

During the Clone Wars, the planet Cato Neimoidia was conquered by the Galactic Republic

The base-of-operations for the Trade Federation, the Cato Neimoidian government had previously tried to take a neutral stance in the war, but the planet instead became a hotly contested battleground for both the Republic and CIS. The Federation's importance to the war made the Republic seek control over the planet; After the Republic's conquest, the Separatists sought to take Cato Neimoidia back

The conquest of Cato Neimoidia was first mentioned in the Databank A-Z section of Star Wars Helmet Collection 9, for a December 9, 2014, release. Further detail, such as the planet having been under Separatist control before the Republic attack, was established by the Droid Directory segment of Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 44 The 2022 novel Brotherhood by Mike Chen would go onto feature Cato Neimoidia in a heavy capacity, establishing it as a neutral world during the early Clone Wars. As such, how Cato Neimoidia fell to the Separatists before the conquest—such was whether the world willing joined the Confederacy at some point after Brotherhood events or if it had been annexed by the Separatists via a conquest or invasion of their own—has not yet been confirmed as of the present.
